THE SHEET IMAGE OF THE SAVE IS DAMAGED: in the picture the deck object points to (data/tts/she-hulk.json, deck.identity.face) only the first row (idx 0-7: Omega-Level Threat x2, The Savage She-Hulk x2, Sensational x3, the first Legalese) is She-Hulk's; the other 22 cells show Dr. Jill Trent's cards. So only idx 0-7 could be read from the image. The order of idx 8-29 is an ASSUMPTION that follows the other heroes' sheets (attack, versatile, defense, scheme): Legalese x3 (idx 7-9), then Nerve Cluster Strike, Cease and Desist and Green Energy (versatile, in unmatched-memory's order), Lady Justice and The Defense Rests (defense), Jennifer Walters, Esq., Leap Toward and Double Jeopardy (schemes). Titles, types, boost values, copies (xN) and texts come from unmatched-memory (the first-row cards agree with the images). The ability (JUST THROW SOMETHING) is a start-of-turn trigger of the effects file (plugin shehulk:throw), not data here.
